name: Advanced Manufacturing
summary: The current shelf combines a national manufacturing-economy baseline with metrology data, institute and roadmap records, packaging awards, materials processing, workforce coordination, and delivered hardware. It supports named stages without treating national trends, awards, testbeds, or components as production scale.
watch_questions: Which national manufacturing trends can be connected to named establishments, facilities, equipment, output, investment, trade, and customers?
Which institute, roadmap, metrology, and award records progress into qualified processes, repeatable yield, throughput, cost, reliability, and production?
Where do materials, tooling, standards, utilities, labor, and supplier networks limit conversion of designs into deployable systems?
